field_search_indexes.description: List of field search index configurations.
field_search_indexes.type:
list(object({
    name             = string
    type             = optional(string, "long")
    alias            = optional(string, null)
    case_sensitive   = optional(bool, false)
    include_chinese  = optional(bool, false)
    token            = optional(string, null)
    enable_analytics = optional(bool, true)
  }))

i18n.zh-Hans: 字段搜索索引配置列表。
i18n.en-US: List of field search index configurations.
